critical_issues: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) is critically delayed at 4.2 s, exceeding Google's 2.5s Core Web Vitals threshold.

important_issues: Keyword gap for high-intent search query 'dental implants cost pune' currently dropping to rank position 11.3.

quickWins: Add 'geo' (latitude/longitude) and 'openingHours' to Dentist JSON-LD schema (effort: 30 minutes).
Compress hero banner image to modern WebP format and apply fetchpriority='high' (effort: 45 minutes).
Update Homepage H1 to include localized target phrase: 'Dental Clinic in Pune' (effort: 15 minutes).
Defer non-critical JavaScript bundle to eliminate render-blocking penalty (effort: 1 hour).

recommendations.finding: LCP is 4.2 s due to unoptimized hero image assets and 420 KiB unused JS delaying the main viewport render.
recommendations.fix: Convert hero images to WebP/AVIF format with width/height attributes, preload the primary LCP image tag, and defer non-critical third-party analytics scripts.
recommendations.falsifiability_check: PageSpeed Insights mobile LCP drops under 2.4s and Core Web Vitals audit badge turns green in Search Console within 14 days.

recommendations.finding: Dentist Schema is missing geo coordinates (latitude/longitude) and openingHoursSpecification required for the Pune Google 3-Pack.
recommendations.fix: Update Schema.org script to include 'geo': {'@type': 'GeoCoordinates', 'latitude': '18.5204', 'longitude': '73.8567'} and explicit opening hours.
recommendations.falsifiability_check: Rich Results Test verifies 0 warnings on LocalBusiness, and Google Search Console reports valid Merchant/Local Listing schema.

recommendations.finding: High intent commercial keyword 'dental implants cost pune' has low CTR (3.5%) and position 11.3 (Page 2).
recommendations.fix: Create a dedicated procedural cost guide page for 'Dental Implants Cost in Pune' featuring transparent price ranges, EMI details, and an FAQ section.
recommendations.falsifiability_check: Google Search Console average position moves from 11.3 to top 5 within 28 days of indexing.

recommendations.finding: 2 render-blocking resources and 3 index coverage errors detected preventing optimal crawl budget utilization.
recommendations.fix: Resolve the 3 crawl 404/redirect errors in Search Console and inline critical CSS while deferring secondary font files.
recommendations.falsifiability_check: Index coverage report in GSC shows 0 errors and server response time drops below 300ms.

recommendations.finding: Content depth is relatively thin on individual service offerings compared to competitors competitorA.com and competitorB.com.
recommendations.fix: Expand service pages to minimum 800+ words with localized patient testimonials, doctor credentials, and step-by-step procedure breakdown.
recommendations.falsifiability_check: Organic impressions increase by >35% on DataForSEO tracked keywords within 60 days.
